summary: Qfin Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a scheduled board meeting on May 26, 2026 to approve its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results, with results publication on May 27, 2026 and an earnings call thereafter. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation filing. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or structural change is mentioned. The filing serves only to notify investors of the timing for quarterly results and the related earnings call.
